explanation: The king of Israel who is involved in several wars and conflicts in 1 Kings 20.
The king of Aram who attacks Ahab and Israel, but is ultimately defeated.
A person who receives messages from God and conveys them to the people. Prophets play an important role in this story by giving advice and warnings to Ahab.
Another name for God, used to show respect and reverence. In 1 Kings 20, the Lord helps Ahab defeat Ben-Hadad.
The capital city of the kingdom of Israel, which Ben-Hadad besieges in 1 Kings 20.
A person who performs services or work for another person, often a superior. In this context, it refers to the prophet's servant, who carries out tasks on behalf of the prophet.
When one party wins over another in a conflict or war. In this chapter, Ben-Hadad and his army are defeated by Ahab and the army of Israel.
An agreement or commitment between two parties. Ahab makes a covenant with Ben-Hadad after defeating him.
